{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicate patient_id entries, keeping the highest sample_seq for each patient
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Verify the data is now clean
print("After deduplication, shape:", trial_df.shape)

# Calculate response rate per site: (number of responded = 1) / (total count)
response_rates = trial_df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean()

# Sort by response rate descending
response_rates_sorted = response_rates.sort_values(ascending=False)

# Get the site with the highest response rate
highest_response_site = response_rates_sorted.index[0]
highest_response_rate = response_rates_sorted.iloc[0]

print("Response rates per site:\n", response_rates_sorted)
print("\nSite with highest response rate: ", highest_response_site)
print("Highest response rate: ", highest_response_rate)"}
